assign.card: ProcessRunner: two build processes stuck between steps

findings.text: Cause 1 is fixed as the brief asked (`Servex/ProcessRunner.js:189`, a second read before `pulse`/`wait`), but the folder does not show *why* the run after a refused `wait` never started the next step: `after_turn` ends in `run(file)`, which reads the file again, sees the step complete and should start `execute`. The likely real cause of the stall is cause 2 (no tick finds a 10-20 folder). The brief said "prove each", and nothing in `session.jsonl` records that proof.

The race test's last check (`Servex/ProcessRunner.test.mjs`, "race: the next step started") would also pass on the old code, because the refused `wait` replays as complete and `run()` moves on anyway. Only the "no wait" and "no second pulse" checks prove the fix. A test asserting a `spawn` line for the next step would be stronger.

The post-merge check is still open: once vscode-mastermind restarts Servex, someone must confirm that `core-plugin-one-plugin-system-for-every/task.jsonl` has a `spawn` line for `execute` and `marked-lines-migrate-every-file-to-the-n/task.jsonl` has one for `plan`. A fresh agent can find this ask in requirements.md, but no line in the task folder marks it as pending.
`tick()` calls `save_index()` once per missing file inside the loop (`Servex/ProcessRunner.js:217`). One save after the loop would do.

Indexing is complete. `processes.json` is in `.gitignore`, has a row in `ai/queue/readme.md`, and is covered in `core/Task/doc/process.md:85`. One stale line predates this diff: `Servex/readme.md:28` still says ProcessRunner "runs a work process's phases" (they are called steps now).

answer.reply: noted: the stall was cause 2 plus cause 1 together; cause 1's stale write is proven by the prefix replay of the core-plugin log (pulse line 28, wait lines 30 and 35 written after improve-plan was complete), cause 2 by TaskDirs.list(2) excluding the 10/20 folder. The index fixes recovery whichever path stalled run().
noted: only the no-wait and no-second-pulse checks prove the race fix; the spawn check stays as a guard that the process still moves on.
noted: after the merge and the Servex restart, confirm both processes have a spawn line for execute / plan; reported to vscode-mastermind.
noted: the save only happens for files that no longer exist; left as is.
noted: the Servex/readme.md 'phases' wording predates this change; left.

complete.outcome: Merged (2368cacd4). Cause 1: after_turn re-reads the file before pulse/wait and skips a complete step. Cause 2: ProcessRunner keeps a gitignored index ai/queue/processes.json of running processes (rebuilt by one 60-day scan), so the tick resumes a process in an old-dated folder; TaskLoop.find_task_files takes a days argument. Cause 3: Dropped.step_complete skips a complete step's stopped agent. Tests: ProcessRunner.test.mjs 51 passing, Dropped.test.mjs passing; the race and drop tests fail without their fix. Still to do after a Servex restart: confirm core-plugin (execute) and marked-lines (plan) each get a spawn line.
